description: This Java source file defines the class DeleteFeaturesResponse, which represents the response to a DeleteFeatures command in a concepts and operations related to hierarchical 'thing' identifiers, headers, and JSON payloads within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing, serializing, and deserializing such responses, and references various external Ditto and JSON utility classes.
